name: ordinary-day
about: Two campaigns with leads, a month's spend and two mature cohorts beside a young one.

output.headline: On 2026-11-03, 2 campaigns delivered 7 leads across 14,600 impressions at a combined cost per lead of $40.61.
points: Total spend for the day was $284.25 across 203 clicks and a click rate of 1.4%.
Regional Class A — Joliet was the stronger performer, bringing in 6 of the day's leads at $30.75 cost per lead on $184.50 spend, 9,120 impressions, 141 clicks, and a 1.5% click rate.

Dedicated night runs spent $99.75 for 1 lead at $99.75 cost per lead, with 5,480 impressions, 62 clicks, and a 1.1% click rate — worth keeping an eye on given the gap in cost per lead between the 2 campaigns.
Month-to-date spend on Meta stands at $612.30 for 2026-11, with 28 days left in the month.
The mature 2026-09-21 cohort shows 38 leads with a hire rate of 10.5% and a contact rate of 86.8%; the 2026-09-28 cohort of 40 leads reached a 12.5% hire rate and 90.0% contact rate.
The 2026-10-26 cohort has 12 leads — 9 contacted, 3 qualified, 1 applied, and 1 lost — but it is too young to judge its rates.
